purpose: The complete Unstructured Ocean Village and the complete CTOV beach village, with the T&T lighthouse set, coastal donors and Nautical market and wall studies, for selecting the Nautical Coast catalog.
worldNote: Placed in the trio test world beside the Polynesian and Alpine galleries.
selectionRule: Every Ocean Village building, lamp and pier piece; every standalone CTOV beach piece, roads omitted, with other mods' blocks shown as neutral vanilla markers; the T&T beach lighthouse set and both T&T beach camps; vanilla-block donors for missing roles; and the shared Birch market and wall geometry in the beach picks' materials.

Every container in a catalog building is personal, shared or castle evidence storage (prepare.py's rule), so none is left as decoration.
closeOutNotes: The castle is the ruling seat (the king's LEADER post); the centre has none. A castle also needs guard posts and a jailer post by the prison (BuildingCatalogContract requires LEADER and GUARD work for a castle).
The castle's baker and blacksmith stations need the matching grants in the live cost contract, as the Mediterranean castle has.
The centre carries town storage itself; NC05.3 supplies the storehouse definition the style needs to be selectable.
Check access on the camp's upper levels after the ladder removal; only lanterns stand above the deck.
Several CTOV beach roofs are made of campfires; they stay decoration, not village fires.
Beds share personal containers by reach at authoring: NC10.3 pairs two beds per chest; the tavern keeper's couple bed is chosen then.
